protocol.model_origin: Unchanged fluid from configs/surface_stratified_pr_gas.json; same methane/ethane parameters and kij=0 used by the capillary FIM examples.
protocol.initialization: Wilson estimate from fixed component critical constants; pressure scales 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 4; no measured pressure or vapor composition used.
protocol.qualification: All 17 measured states. Marginal archived expanded uncertainties are diagnostics, not a predeclared overall industrial acceptance threshold.

uncertainty_scope: Marginal comparison with archived combined expanded 95% property bounds; no covariance or joint statistical acceptance claim. Wide bounds retained, no errors used for selection.
qualification: Only conditional binary bubble pressure and vapor composition. Constructed half-liquid/half-vapor feed is a numerical stability cross-check, not a measured vapor fraction. No caloric, water, pipe-hydraulics or complete-plant qualification.
